proof_requests: Send a photo of the full table assembled and standing (side view) showing how it stands without extra parts.
Send close-up photos of all corners and edges of the glass (front/back/left/right).
Send a photo/video showing all included parts (legs/stand pieces, screws/brackets).
If possible, send a photo of any glass marking/label confirming tempered glass (underside/edge).
response.reason: The photo confirms a rectangular black glass tabletop, but key pricing factors are unclear: whether the legs/stand are truly missing and the exact glass condition at corners/edges. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
